jobs.title: Optical Product Engineer
jobs.description: Strong background in optics or optical engineering, including imaging systems, lenses, illumination, and optical sensors Experience with optical design and analysis tools (e.g., Zemax, Code V, or similar), including simulation and modeling workflows Hands-on experience with lab measurement and testing, including optical benches, alignment tools, and instrumentation for optical characterization

jobs.title: Opto-Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. Minimum 5 years of experience in mechanical and/or opto-mechanical design of products or precision equipment Strong grasp of GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis Experience owning the mechanical domain of a project end to end (from industrial/concept design through detailed design and validation)
